name: The MuZeum
source:
I was at a dead-end, desperately battling a horde of zombies coming at us with my friend.

But a man opened the door of the building next to us and saved us at the crucial moment. 

Turns out he's the curator of the Natural History Museum we're in currently... He even generously offered us to stay the night until it’s safe to leave again in the morning. 

I feel so moved, seeing there are still some good people in this wrecked world...

...That’s good and all, but what am I doing, going on a guided tour with him in the dead of the night?

And there’s even pop quizzes?! Man, school being out was the one good thing about the apocalypse… How is he so motivated to continue sharing his knowledge, when we’re at the end of the world? 

"Proceed with caution", he says. "There might still be creatures roaming around the halls…"

Didn’t you say this place was safe?!

[From [url=https://arghbulous.itch.io/the-muzeum]itch.io[/url]]
